nodes.name: Sock 01
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: Three Zakus enter the laundromat in formation, each carrying a basket above his eye.{pause}Commander counts six socks, pauses, and counts the same six socks with greater authority.{pause}The seventh sock is absent, striped, and apparently willing to embarrass the whole unit.{pause}A dryer turns in the corner like it knows something and has requested legal counsel.

nodes.name: Sock 02
nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.dialogue: Nobody leaves until the missing sock returns to its assigned ankle deployment.{pause}Check every cuff, drum, basket, folding table, and suspiciously sock-shaped detergent bottle.{pause}Line Zaku opens a notebook titled Operation Paired Footwear and immediately loses the pencil.{pause}Char finds the pencil behind his ear, where nobody had thought to check for the sock.

nodes.name: Sock 03
nodes.speaker: Line Zaku
nodes.dialogue: I suggest a calm inventory before this becomes one of our loud domestic campaigns.{pause}Commander declares that calm inventory is exactly what he ordered, only with more urgency.{pause}They line up shirts, towels, and one tiny apron that nobody admits belongs to him.{pause}The apron receives temporary officer status because its pockets might contain evidence.

nodes.name: Sock 04
nodes.speaker: Char
nodes.dialogue: The red washer can finish a load three times faster than an ordinary civilian appliance.{pause}Line Zaku asks whether it also finds individual socks, which is not in the brochure.{pause}Char taps the lid anyway; the machine answers with a confident and expensive clunk.{pause}Commander writes down hostile clunk, then underlines it until the paper tears.

nodes.name: Sock 05
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: A dryer sheet glides across the floor and all three Zakus turn to track it.{pause}For six dramatic seconds, the sheet is treated as an enemy scout wearing spring fragrance.{pause}It lodges under a plastic chair and reveals nothing except two quarters and lint.{pause}Commander confiscates the quarters for mission expenses and the lint for questioning.

nodes.name: Sock 06
nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.dialogue: Describe the missing article again, and this time omit all emotional interpretation.{pause}Line Zaku reports one blue sock, white stripes, reinforced heel, and dependable character.{pause}Char remembers it as gray, plain, and openly jealous of the red washer.{pause}The investigation now has two descriptions and no sock, which Commander calls progress.

nodes.name: Sock 07
nodes.speaker: Line Zaku
nodes.dialogue: We should interview the other customers without making the laundromat feel occupied.{pause}Commander lowers his voice from parade volume to what he considers a confidential parade.{pause}An old GM folding towels says socks vanish when rushed, ignored, or fed to fitted sheets.{pause}Char writes fitted sheet on the suspect board and draws a very menacing rectangle.

nodes.name: Sock 08
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: They inspect the fitted sheet by stretching it between three sets of metal hands.{pause}The sheet snaps loose and wraps Commander like a small, furious laundry dumpling.{pause}His antenna remains visible, along with something soft fluttering near its base.{pause}Nobody notices because Commander is delivering instructions from inside a floral cloud.

nodes.name: Sock 09
nodes.speaker: Char
nodes.dialogue: We could simply wash everything again and let superior speed expose the truth.{pause}Line Zaku argues that washing evidence is generally discouraged by every detective serial.{pause}Commander escapes the sheet and pretends the last minute was a restraint readiness drill.{pause}The old GM awards the drill a polite six out of ten and keeps folding.

nodes.name: Sock 10
nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.dialogue: Two methods remain: disciplined sorting or a machine-assisted signal sweep.{pause}Sorting respects procedure, while sweeping respects how close the snack machine is to{pause}closing.{pause}The team looks at the baskets, then at the blinking red washer, then at Commander.{pause}Commander decides democracy is acceptable when every option still sounds like his idea.

nodes.name: Sock Fold 1
nodes.speaker: Line Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Sorting protocol begins with whites, colors, delicates, towels, and items of uncertain{pause}allegiance.{pause}Char objects to uncertain allegiance until a red handkerchief appears in the white pile.{pause}Commander creates a neutral basket and stations it exactly between both laundry{pause}blocs.{pause}The old GM quietly moves the handkerchief before it can trigger a rinse-cycle incident.

nodes.name: Sock Fold 2
nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.dialogue: Every item receives a number, a category, and a short statement about its whereabouts.{pause}A pillowcase refuses to cooperate by being empty no matter how sternly it is searched.{pause}Line Zaku finds the missing pencil, three buttons, and a coupon that expired yesterday.{pause}They find no sock, but the baskets now look excellent enough for an inspection photograph.

nodes.name: Sock Scan 1
nodes.speaker: Char
nodes.dialogue: Machine sweep begins with a coin tapped against every washer like a tiny sonar hammer.{pause}Normal machines answer ting; the red washer answers with something closer to a victory{pause}speech.{pause}Commander orders a second pass because victory speeches are not standard appliance behavior.{pause}The dryer contributes a lonely button, which rolls away before anyone can interview it.

nodes.name: Sock Scan 2
nodes.speaker: Line Zaku
nodes.dialogue: The sweep detects four paper clips, a zipper, and Commander's misplaced mission quarters.{pause}Char claims the quarters were intentionally placed to calibrate his highly scientific tapping.{pause}Commander accepts this explanation because recovering the budget makes it sound convincing.{pause}No sock appears, but every machine now has a chalk circle and feels deeply accused.

nodes.name: Sock 11
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: The main washer melody returns as the investigation reconvenes beside the folding table.{pause}Sorting improved morale; scanning improved the number of objects arranged in evidence bags.{pause}Neither method explained the soft blue shape still fluttering behind Commander's antenna.{pause}The old GM notices it again, smiles, and decides the lesson should finish naturally.

nodes.name: Sock 12
nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.dialogue: We reconstruct the sock's final known movements from basket to washer to dryer.{pause}Line Zaku carried the basket; Char chose the machine; Commander supervised from a safe{pause}stool.{pause}The stool is examined and cleared, though it seems pleased to have been included.{pause}Char notes that Commander leaned into the basket while searching for the detergent cap.

nodes.name: Sock 13
nodes.speaker: Char
nodes.dialogue: Perhaps the sock attached itself to a superior commander through static attraction.{pause}Commander says superior is accurate, but attached is unsupported and therefore disrespectful.{pause}Line Zaku lifts a dryer sheet toward Commander's helmet; it sticks instantly to one shoulder.{pause}They all stare at it, then agree that one sample does not establish a sock conspiracy.

nodes.name: Sock 14
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: The red washer finishes its cycle with a cheerful beep and an unnecessary internal light show.{pause}Steam rises when Char opens it, posing him like the hero of a detergent commercial.{pause}Inside, every garment has twisted into one damp rope with a towel at its center.{pause}Commander names the formation Textile Serpent and orders a careful untangling maneuver.

nodes.name: Sock 15
nodes.speaker: Line Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Untangling requires the three Zakus to walk backward around the laundromat in a circle.{pause}The rope passes under chairs, over baskets, and briefly through the snack machine handle.{pause}A bag of crackers drops, which Commander records as the operation's first material gain.{pause}The sock is not in the rope, but one towel now resembles a ceremonial sash.

nodes.name: Sock 16
nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.dialogue: We need a witness who understands disappearance, static, and the habits of small clothing.{pause}The old GM is promoted to Civilian Laundry Advisor before he can decline the badge.{pause}He asks one question: where did Commander stand when the sock was first reported missing?{pause}Commander points beneath the ceiling fan, where static has made his antenna hum.

nodes.name: Sock 17
nodes.speaker: Old GM
nodes.dialogue: Sometimes a missing thing is not gone; it is riding with the loudest person present.{pause}Commander thanks him, then orders everyone to inspect Char because Char speaks very loudly.{pause}Char rotates once while Line Zaku checks his shoulders, backpack, and elbow guards.{pause}They find a clothespin, which Char insists is tactical, but still no missing sock.

nodes.name: Sock 18
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: A child drops a mitten near the machines, and the Zakus launch an immediate recovery drill.{pause}Line Zaku catches it before it touches the floor; Commander presents it with both hands.{pause}The child says thanks and points at Commander's head, but a parent hurries them away.{pause}Commander believes the pointing was recognition of leadership and stands even straighter.

nodes.name: Sock 19
nodes.speaker: Line Zaku
nodes.dialogue: Our evidence suggests static, proximity, and a commander who refuses to turn around slowly.{pause}Commander agrees to a controlled rotation but demands formal countdown and adequate clearance.{pause}Char counts from ten with such ceremony that two customers pause to watch.{pause}At three, the sock swings into view; at two, it swings back behind the antenna.

nodes.name: Sock 20
nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.dialogue: Rotation complete. I detected no irregularities and looked exceptionally balanced throughout.{pause}Line Zaku requests one repeat at half speed, but Commander declares the test conclusive.{pause}The title march returns from the radio as if announcing the final stage of a campaign.{pause}Char salutes the radio, bumps the detergent, and covers the floor in blue powder.

nodes.name: Sock 21
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: The team sweeps detergent into a neat blue ridge using three membership cards.{pause}Commander says the spill is useful because footprints may reveal the sock's escape route.{pause}Every footprint belongs to a Zaku, except one tiny trail made by the old GM's cart.{pause}The cart is searched, cleared, and given a complimentary cracker for cooperation.

nodes.name: Sock 22
nodes.speaker: Char
nodes.dialogue: If the sock cannot be found, we can create a replacement from the ceremonial towel.{pause}Line Zaku explains that cutting a large towel makes a small wet bag, not a sock.{pause}Commander considers issuing one bag per foot and calling the design field equipment.{pause}The old GM coughs gently, which makes the sock flutter like a tiny signal flag.

nodes.name: Sock 23
nodes.speaker: Line Zaku
nodes.dialogue: There! Something moved behind Commander's antenna when the advisor coughed.{pause}Commander freezes, worried that a moth has penetrated the upper command structure.{pause}Char approaches with salad tongs, the only tool long enough and not covered in soap.{pause}The old GM suggests using one hand, but nobody wants to abandon proper equipment.

nodes.name: Sock 24
nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.dialogue: Proceed carefully. This helmet contains sensitive systems and several excellent decisions.{pause}Char grips the blue fabric with the tongs and slowly pulls it into the light.{pause}One white stripe appears, then a second, followed by the reinforced and dependable heel.{pause}Line Zaku whispers the sock's name, which is apparently Lieutenant Lefty.

nodes.name: Sock 25
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: The missing sock has been riding Commander's antenna since the fitted-sheet incident.{pause}Commander claims this proves he kept the objective under direct personal protection.{pause}Line Zaku points out that the incident happened after the sock was declared missing.{pause}Char recommends celebrating before the timeline becomes damaging to senior leadership.{pause}The dryer beeps twice, closing the investigation before anyone requests a formal chronology.

nodes.name: Sock 26
nodes.speaker: Line Zaku
nodes.dialogue: The room goes quiet while Line Zaku lifts the sock from Commander's antenna.{pause}One edge is warm, and three blue lint threads match the fitted sheet exactly.{pause}Char finds the partner sock waiting beneath the basket where everyone searched first.{pause}Commander orders both socks placed together before coincidence can separate them again.{pause}For once, the whole squad obeys without asking whether pairing counts as formation.

nodes.name: Sock 27
nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.dialogue: They empty every machine and make one honest pile of everything still unpaired.{pause}Two towels find their corners, four shirts recover sleeves, and one mitten remains mysterious.{pause}The red washer gives a gentle clunk as if volunteering to guard the next load.{pause}Line Zaku writes a tiny loss report, then crosses out the word disaster.{pause}Commander studies the calmer room and admits the mission produced useful laundry.

nodes.name: Sock 28
nodes.speaker: Char
nodes.dialogue: Char spreads the recovered socks across the folding table like a peace conference.{pause}A strict sorting protocol would label every basket and record every future transfer.{pause}Trusting the red washer would keep the ritual simple and give the old machine a job.{pause}Both plans protect the pair, but they teach the squad different lessons about control.{pause}Commander straightens his antenna and asks everyone to choose before another sheet arrives.

nodes.name: Sock A1
nodes.speaker: Line Zaku
nodes.dialogue: The team chooses a final sorting protocol so Lieutenant Lefty can rejoin a clean pair.{pause}Whites go here, colors there, towels north, and lint receives its own jurisdiction.{pause}Commander personally labels each basket while quietly removing antenna from the equipment list.{pause}The old GM approves the new system and returns the borrowed advisor badge.

nodes.name: Sock A2
nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.dialogue: Every sock now checks in before washing and signs out after drying.{pause}Char asks how socks sign; Commander demonstrates a stamp shaped like a tiny heel.{pause}Line Zaku pairs Lieutenant Lefty with the patiently waiting Righty and salutes them both.{pause}For the first time all afternoon, the laundromat contains exactly zero missing garments.

nodes.name: Sock A3
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: The three baskets leave in neat formation, balanced and correctly inventoried.{pause}Commander wears a dryer sheet on his antenna as an official static warning pennant.{pause}The child with the mitten sees it through the window and points again, delighted.{pause}This time Commander bows, finally understanding that not every point is a salute.

nodes.name: Sock A4
nodes.speaker: Old GM
nodes.dialogue: Next week they return with paired socks, labeled bags, and a seven-page checklist.{pause}They also bring the tiny apron, cleaned and promoted to basket logistics officer.{pause}The old GM keeps the advisor badge behind the counter for the next domestic emergency.{pause}On the wall, a sign now reads: CHECK YOUR ANTENNA BEFORE REPORTING A LOSS.

nodes.name: Sock B1
nodes.speaker: Char
nodes.dialogue: The team chooses the red washer for one triumphant reunion cycle at maximum speed.{pause}Lieutenant Lefty and Righty enter together, accompanied by every pale towel in the baskets.{pause}Line Zaku asks whether red dye can travel three times faster than ordinary dye.{pause}Char closes the lid before the question can become an objection.

nodes.name: Sock B2
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: The washer hums, accelerates, and develops the confidence of a parade drum.{pause}Pink foam presses against the glass while Commander insists the color is warning crimson.{pause}The old GM hands Line Zaku a stain-removal pamphlet without being asked.{pause}When the lid unlocks, every towel looks faster and every sock looks promoted.

nodes.name: Sock B3
nodes.speaker: Commander
nodes.dialogue: The outcome is not a laundry mistake; it is a successful unit-wide color standardization.{pause}Line Zaku holds up Lieutenant Lefty, now pink except for one stubborn white stripe.{pause}Char calls the stripe a racing accent and requests credit for the design.{pause}Commander grants credit only after Char accepts responsibility for future wash labels.

nodes.name: Sock B4
nodes.speaker: Narrator
nodes.dialogue: They march home wearing pink towels as capes and carrying the red washer's brochure.{pause}The child with the mitten applauds; the old GM rates the formation eight out of ten.{pause}At home, Righty and Lefty dry side by side without disappearing or filing complaints.{pause}Commander adds one final rule to the notebook: SPEED IS NOT A COLOR SETTING.
